g.text: Usage: rkd [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
🚀 Rocketdoo - Odoo Development Framework
Options:
--version Show the version and exit.
-v, --verbose Enable verbose mode for detailed output
-c, --config PATH Path to custom configuration file
--help Show this message and exit.
Commands:
build Builds the Docker image for Rocketdoo.
ci CI/CD helpers for a generated Rocketdoo project.
del Delete unwanted files from the project.
deploy 🚀 Deploy modules to VPS or Odoo.sh
deploy-config Manage deployment configuration
deploy-init Initialize deployment configuration
deploy-list List all detected Odoo modules
deploy-run Deploy modules to a target
deploy-validate Validate modules before deployment
docker Docker commands replaced by Rocketdoo.
down Equivalent to: docker compose down
gitman Manage external repositories via gitman.yaml.
gui Launch the Rocketdoo web GUI.
help Display detailed help information for specific commands.
info Display detailed information about the current project...
init Initialize environment configuration, interactively or...
instance Deploy complete Odoo instances to VPS (stage / prod).
logs Equivalent to: docker logs -f <container>
mail Manage Mailpit email testing service.
pack 📦 Package the development environment to share with...
pause Equivalent to: docker compose pause
profiles Show the supported Odoo / PostgreSQL / edition...
restart Equivalent to: docker compose restart
scaffold Generate base project structure and configuration files.
status Equivalent to: docker compose ps
stop Equivalent to: docker compose stop
traefik Manage Traefik reverse proxy integration.
unpack 📥 Start a development environment shared by another...
up Equivalent to: docker compose up
